info.name: ecom-mern API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the ecom-mern backend.

**Base URL:** `{{baseUrl}}` (default: `http://localhost:5000`)

---

## Authentication

### Admin / Staff routes
Protected endpoints use `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`.
The token is a **short-lived JWT** returned by `POST /api/auth/login`.
Set the `accessToken` environment variable after a successful login.

The collection-level auth is set to **Bearer Token → `{{accessToken}}`**.
All protected Admin requests inherit it automatically.

### Customer routes
Customer-protected endpoints use `Authorization: Bearer {{customerAccessToken}}`.
Set `customerAccessToken` after `POST /api/customers/auth/login`.

### Refresh Tokens
Both Admin and Customer refresh tokens are stored in **HttpOnly cookies**.
Postman handles cookies automatically as long as the Cookie Jar is enabled.

---

## Roles
| Role | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `super_admin` | Full access incl. user management & registration |
| `admin` | Products, categories, brands, inventory, banners |
| `staff` | Read-only access to most resources |

request.description: Returns server uptime and health status. No authentication required.

item.name: Admin — Auth
item.description:
Admin/staff authentication endpoints.

**Rate limits:**
- Login & Register: 10 requests per 15 minutes per IP
- Refresh: 30 requests per 15 minutes per IP

request.description:
Authenticates an admin/staff user.

**Returns:** `accessToken` (JWT, short-lived) in the response body. A `refreshToken` HttpOnly cookie is set automatically.

**Rate limit:** 10 requests per 15-minute window.

**Required fields:**
- `email` — string, valid email format
- `password` — string, min 1 character

**Error codes:**
- `401` — Invalid email or password
- `403` — Account deactivated
- `429` — Rate limit exceeded

Creates a new admin panel user. **Only `super_admin` can call this.**

**Required fields:**
- `name` — string, min 1 character
- `email` — string, valid email format
- `password` — string, min 6 characters

**Optional fields:**
- `role` — enum: `super_admin` | `admin` | `staff` (default: `staff`)

**Error codes:**
- `401` — Not authenticated
- `403` — Not authorized (not super_admin)
- `409` — Email already in use
- `422` — Validation error

Exchanges the `refreshToken` HttpOnly cookie for a new access token.

**No request body needed.** The refresh token is read automatically from the cookie jar.

**Rate limit:** 30 requests per 15-minute window.

**Error codes:**
- `401` — No/invalid/expired/revoked refresh token

Revokes the `refreshToken` cookie and clears it. No request body needed.

The access token remains valid until it expires (short-lived by design).

item.name: Admin — Users
item.description:
Admin panel user management. All routes require `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`.

**Access:** `super_admin` only (except `GET /api/users/me` which any authenticated admin role can call).

request.description:
Returns the authenticated admin/staff user's own profile.

**Access:** Any authenticated admin role (super_admin, admin, staff).

query.description: Filter by role: super_admin | admin | staff
Filter by active status: true | false

request.description:
Lists all admin panel users with optional filters and pagination.

**Access:** `super_admin` only.

**Query parameters:**
- `page` — number (default: 1)
- `limit` — number (default: 20, max: 100)
- `role` — enum: `super_admin` | `admin` | `staff`
- `isActive` — `true` | `false`
- `search` — partial name search

Fetches a single admin user by MongoDB ObjectId.

**Access:** `super_admin` only.

**Path params:**
- `userId` — MongoDB ObjectId of the user

**Error codes:** `404` — User not found

Updates a user's `name`, `role`, or `isActive` status.

**Access:** `super_admin` only.

**Restrictions:**
- A super_admin cannot change their own role or deactivate themselves.

**All fields are optional:**
- `name` — string, min 1 character
- `role` — enum: `super_admin` | `admin` | `staff`
- `isActive` — boolean

**Error codes:**
- `400` — Self-modification of role/status blocked
- `404` — User not found

Hard-deletes a user and revokes all their refresh tokens.

**Access:** `super_admin` only.

**Restrictions:** A super_admin cannot delete themselves.

**Error codes:**
- `400` — Self-deletion blocked
- `404` — User not found

Returns aggregated statistics:
- Total product / category / brand counts
- Low-stock variants (below configured threshold)
- 10 most recent activity log entries
- 5 most recent CSV import jobs

**Access:** Any authenticated admin role.

item.name: Admin — Brands
item.description:
Brand management. Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`.

**Access:**
- GET: any authenticated admin role
- POST, PUT, DELETE: `super_admin` or `admin` only

request.description: Returns all brands sorted alphabetically by name.

Fetches a single brand by MongoDB ObjectId.

**Error codes:** `404` — Brand not found

Creates a new brand. The `slug` is auto-generated server-side from `name`.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Required fields:**
- `name` — string, min 2 chars, max 100 chars

**Optional fields:**
- `logo` — valid URL string
- `isActive` — boolean (default: true)

Updates a brand. All fields are optional.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

If `name` is changed, `slug` is regenerated automatically.

**Error codes:** `404` — Brand not found

Deletes a brand.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Blocked if:** any product is currently assigned to this brand.

**Error codes:**
- `400` — Brand has products assigned to it
- `404` — Brand not found

response.name: 400 Brand In Use

item.name: Admin — Categories
item.description:
Category management. Supports nested categories via the `parent` field.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`.

**Access:**
- GET: any authenticated admin role
- POST, PUT, DELETE: `super_admin` or `admin` only

request.description: Returns all categories sorted alphabetically by name.

Fetches a single category by MongoDB ObjectId.

**Error codes:** `404` — Category not found

Creates a new category. The `slug` is auto-generated from `name`.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Required fields:**
- `name` — string, min 2 chars, max 100 chars

**Optional fields:**
- `description` — string
- `parent` — MongoDB ObjectId of parent category (for nested categories)
- `isActive` — boolean (default: true)
- `image.url` — string
- `image.fileId` — string

**Error codes:**
- `400` — Parent category not found

Updates a category. All fields optional.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Error codes:**
- `400` — Category cannot be its own parent
- `400` — Parent category not found
- `404` — Category not found

Deletes a category.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Blocked if:**
- Category has child subcategories
- Any product is assigned to this category

**Error codes:**
- `400` — Has subcategories or products
- `404` — Category not found

item.name: Admin — Products
item.description:
Product management with variant support. All routes require `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`.

**Access:**
- GET: any authenticated admin role
- POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE: `super_admin` or `admin` only

**Note:** Stock is ledger-only — use `POST /api/inventory/movements` to adjust stock levels. Direct stock writes via the product/variant endpoints are intentionally blocked.

query.description: Filter by status: draft | active | archived

request.description:
Creates a product together with at least one variant in a single **transactional** request. Stock is initialized via the inventory ledger (not written directly).

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Required fields:**
- `name` — string, min 2, max 200
- `category` — MongoDB ObjectId (must exist)
- `brand` — MongoDB ObjectId (must exist)
- `variants` — array (min 1 item), each variant requires:
  - `sku` — string, min 1, max 100, globally unique
  - `price` — number ≥ 0
  - `stock` — integer ≥ 0

**Optional variant fields:**
- `barcode` — string
- `options` — array of `{ name, value }` objects
- `salePrice` — number ≥ 0 (must be ≤ price)
- `costPrice` — number ≥ 0
- `weight` — `{ value: number, unit: "g"|"kg"|"lb"|"oz" }`
- `images` — array of `{ url, fileId }`, max 4
- `isActive` — boolean

**Optional product fields:**
- `description`, `status` (draft|active|archived), `featured`, `images`, `optionTypes`, `seo`

**Error codes:**
- `400` — Category or brand not found
- `422` — Validation error

Updates product fields. **Does not modify variants** — use the variant endpoints for that.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`. All fields are optional.

**Note:** Passing `variants` in the body is silently ignored.

**Error codes:**
- `400` — Category or brand not found
- `404` — Product not found

Deletes a product and **cascade-deletes all its variants** in a single transaction.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Error codes:** `404` — Product not found

Bulk-updates `status` and/or `featured` for multiple products in one request.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Required fields:**
- `ids` — non-empty array of MongoDB ObjectIds
- `updates` — object with at least one of:
  - `status` — enum: `draft` | `active` | `archived`
  - `featured` — boolean

**Error codes:** `400` — No IDs or no valid update fields provided

Bulk-deletes products and all their variants in a transaction.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Required fields:**
- `ids` — non-empty array of MongoDB ObjectIds

**Error codes:** `400` — No product IDs provided

item.name: Admin — Product Variants
item.description:
Variant management nested under a product. Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`.

**Important:** Stock cannot be changed here. Use `POST /api/inventory/movements` instead.

**Access:**
- GET: any authenticated admin role
- POST, PUT, DELETE: `super_admin` or `admin` only

request.description: Returns all variants belonging to the specified product.

Fetches a single variant by its ID.

**Error codes:** `404` — Variant not found

Adds a new variant to an existing product.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Required fields:**
- `sku` — string, globally unique
- `price` — number ≥ 0
- `stock` — integer ≥ 0

**Optional fields:**
- `barcode`, `options`, `salePrice` (must be ≤ price), `costPrice`, `weight`, `images` (max 4), `isActive`

**Note:** `product` field is automatically taken from the URL `productId` — do not send it in the body.

Updates variant fields. All fields are optional.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Cannot update:** `product` (immutable) or `stock` (use inventory endpoint).

**Error codes:** `404` — Variant not found

Deletes a variant.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Blocked if:** The variant is the product's only remaining variant (delete the product instead).

**Error codes:**
- `400` — Cannot delete the only variant
- `404` — Variant not found

response.name: 400 Last Variant

item.name: Admin — Inventory
item.description:
Inventory movement ledger. Stock is a derived value computed from movements.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`.

request.description:
Records a stock movement and atomically updates the variant's `stock` field.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Required fields:**
- `variantId` — MongoDB ObjectId
- `type` — enum: `initial` | `restock` | `sale` | `return` | `damage` | `correction`
- `quantity` — number (must be positive **unless** `type` is `correction`, which accepts signed values)

**Optional fields:**
- `reason` — string, max 300 chars

**Type descriptions:**
| Type | Effect |
|------|--------|
| `initial` | Sets initial stock on creation |
| `restock` | Adds stock (positive) |
| `sale` | Reduces stock (positive qty treated as reduction) |
| `return` | Adds stock back |
| `damage` | Reduces stock |
| `correction` | Manual signed adjustment (can be negative) |

Returns paginated movement history for a specific variant, newest first.

**Access:** Any authenticated admin role.

**Path params:**
- `variantId` — MongoDB ObjectId of the variant

Recomputes the variant's stock by summing the entire movement ledger, then compares to the stored `stock` field.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

Useful for detecting drift between `variant.stock` and the true ledger sum.

**Error codes:** `404` — Variant not found

item.name: Admin — Images
item.description:
Image upload to ImageKit CDN. Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin` only.

formdata.description: Image file(s) to upload. Field name must be 'image'. Max 4 files.

request.description:
Uploads 1–4 image files to ImageKit under the `/ecommerce-admin/products` folder.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Request:** `multipart/form-data` with field name `image` (can include multiple files, max 4).

**Returns:** Array of `{ url, fileId, name }` objects — use these in the product/variant `images` array.

**Error codes:** `400` — No image files provided

item.name: Admin — Banners
item.description:
Storefront banner configuration management.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`.

**Banner keys:** `hero`, `budget`, `bottom`
- `hero` and `budget` — use a `slides` array (hero: max 5 slides)
- `bottom` — uses individual fields (title, subtitle, image, href, ctaText, isActive)

**Access:**
- GET: `super_admin`, `admin`, `staff`
- PUT: `super_admin`, `admin` only

request.description: Returns all banner configurations merged with defaults. Includes inactive slides (admin view).

response.name: 200 Success

request.description:
Updates the `hero` or `budget` banner (uses `slides` array format).

Change `:key` in the URL to `budget` to update the budget banner.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Path params:**
- `key` — `hero` | `budget`

**Required in body:**
- `slides` — array of slide objects:
  - `image.url` — string (URL)
  - `image.fileId` — string
  - `href` — string
  - `order` — number
  - `isActive` — boolean

**Constraint:** `hero` banner max 5 slides.

**Error codes:**
- `400` — Invalid banner key or missing slides array

Updates the `bottom` banner (single-image promotional banner).

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**All fields optional:**
- `title` — string
- `subtitle` — string
- `image` — `{ url, fileId }`
- `href` — string
- `ctaText` — string
- `isActive` — boolean

response.name: 200 Success

item.name: Admin — CSV Import
item.description:
Import products from a Shopify-format CSV file. The workflow is:
1. `POST /import/preview` — Upload CSV, get a preview with validation
2. `POST /import/confirm` — Confirm and commit valid rows to the DB
3. `POST /import/:id/rollback` — Undo an import if needed

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`.
**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin` only.

formdata.description: Shopify-format CSV file. Field name must be 'file'.

request.description:
Parses and validates a Shopify-format CSV. **No database writes.** Returns per-row validation results grouped into products.

**Required CSV columns:** Title/Handle, SKU, Price or Compare At Price

**Error codes:**
- `400` — No file provided, empty CSV, or missing required columns

response.name: 200 Success

request.description:
Re-validates and commits only the `valid: true` products from the preview response into the database. Creates an `ImportJob` record for potential rollback.

**Pass the full `products` array from the preview response** — invalid items are automatically skipped.

**Required fields:**
- `products` — array (non-empty) from preview response

**Optional fields:**
- `fileName` — string, for the ImportJob record

Undoes a completed import by deleting all products, variants, categories, and brands that were created during that import. Also cleans up ImageKit files.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Path params:**
- `importJobId` — MongoDB ObjectId of the ImportJob

**Error codes:**
- `400` — Import already rolled back
- `404` — Import job not found

response.name: 200 Success

request.description:
Returns paginated list of ImportJob records for the current user.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Query params:**
- `page`, `limit`
- `status` — `completed` | `rolled_back`

Returns a single ImportJob. Use `status` to determine if rollback is available.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`. Scoped to the requesting user's own jobs.

**Error codes:** `404` — Import job not found or belongs to another user

item.name: Customer — Auth
item.description:
Customer registration, login, session management, and profile.

**Token separation:** Customer tokens carry `type: "customer"` and are **rejected** by admin endpoints (and vice versa).

The customer refresh token cookie is named `customerRefreshToken`.

request.description:
Registers a new customer and immediately logs them in.

**Rate limit:** 10 requests per 15-minute window.

**Required fields:**
- `name` — string, min 2 chars
- `email` — string, valid email
- `password` — string, min 6 chars

**Optional fields:**
- `phone` — string

**Error codes:**
- `409` — Email already in use
- `422` — Validation error

Logs in a customer.

**Rate limit:** 10 requests per 15-minute window.

**Required fields:**
- `email` — string, valid email
- `password` — string

**Error codes:**
- `401` — Invalid credentials
- `403` — Account deactivated

Exchanges the `customerRefreshToken` HttpOnly cookie for a new access token.

**Rate limit:** 30 requests per 15-minute window.
Revokes the `customerRefreshToken` cookie.

Returns the authenticated customer's full profile including addresses.

**Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer {{customerAccessToken}}`

Updates the customer's profile (name, phone) and/or replaces their addresses array.

**Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer {{customerAccessToken}}`

**All fields optional:**
- `name` — string, min 2 chars
- `phone` — string (nullable)
- `addresses` — array; each address:
  - `line1` *(required)* — string
  - `city` *(required)* — string
  - `postalCode` *(required)* — string
  - `country` *(required)* — string
  - `label`, `line2`, `state`, `phone`, `isDefault` — all optional

response.name: 200 Success

item.name: Customer — Cart
item.description:
Shopping cart management.

**Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer {{customerAccessToken}}`

The cart is auto-created on first access (find-or-create). Quantity is automatically clamped to available stock.

request.description: Returns the customer's cart. Creates an empty cart if one doesn't exist. Cart items are populated with variant details (sku, price, salePrice, stock, images) and product details (name, slug).

Adds a variant to the cart. If already present, **increments** the quantity. Quantity is clamped to available stock.

**Required fields:**
- `variantId` — MongoDB ObjectId
- `quantity` — positive integer

**Error codes:**
- `400` — Variant is inactive
- `404` — Variant not found

Sets the quantity of a cart item to the specified value. Quantity is clamped to available stock.

**Passing `quantity: 0` (or negative) removes the item** from the cart.

**Path params:**
- `variantId` — MongoDB ObjectId of the variant

**Required fields:**
- `quantity` — integer ≥ 0

**Error codes:**
- `404` — Cart or item not found

Removes a single line item from the cart.

**Path params:**
- `variantId` — MongoDB ObjectId of the variant to remove

**Error codes:** `404` — Cart not found

Removes all items from the cart.

**Error codes:** `404` — Cart not found

item.name: Customer — Wishlist
item.description:
Wishlist management.

**Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer {{customerAccessToken}}`

The wishlist is auto-created on first access.

request.description: Returns the customer's wishlist with populated products (name, slug, images, brand, category, status) and lightweight variant pricing data.

Adds a product to the wishlist. No-op if already present.

**Required fields:**
- `productId` — MongoDB ObjectId

**Error codes:**
- `400` — Product is not active (status must be `active`)
- `404` — Product not found

Removes a product from the wishlist.

**Path params:**
- `productId` — MongoDB ObjectId of the product

**Error codes:** `404` — Wishlist not found

item.name: Public — Storefront
item.description: Fully public endpoints — no authentication required. Used by the storefront/frontend.

query.description: Filter by category ObjectId or slug

request.description:
Returns a paginated list of **active** products only. Each product includes basic variant pricing (price, salePrice, stock).

**Category filtering supports recursive subcategory inclusion.**

**Query params:**
- `category` — ObjectId or category slug (includes all subcategories)
- `search` — product name substring
- `sort` — `newest` (default) | `featured` | `price_asc` | `price_desc`
- `minPrice` / `maxPrice` — filter by variant price range
- `page`, `limit`

response.name: 200 Success

request.description:
Returns full product details for a single **active** product by its URL slug.

Returns `404` for missing or non-active products (draft/archived are hidden).

**Path params:**
- `slug` — product slug string

Fast autocomplete for search bars. Returns up to 6 matching products and 5 matching categories.

**Query params:**
- `q` — search string (min 2 chars; returns empty results if shorter)

Each product result includes the lowest variant price for display.
Returns active banner configurations for the storefront. Inactive slides are excluded.
